name: wget
description: Network downloader for retrieving files from web servers using HTTP, HTTPS, and FTP

wget.description: Network downloader for retrieving files from web servers using HTTP, HTTPS, and FTP
wget.usage:
wget https://example.com/file.zip
wget -r -np -k https://site.com/
wget --user=username --password=pass ftp://server/file
wget -c https://large-file.zip
wget -O output.html https://example.com
